policy: FDS publishes numerical benchmark scores ONLY when backed by an owner-approved public evaluation export specifying exact model version, base-model identity, benchmark version, evaluation date, test count, evaluation conditions (raw vs. guarded), comparison baseline, uncertainty, and known limitations. Website tests, application regression tests, model evaluations, and commercial certification are never conflated.

records.model: Kayla Copilot Local Canonical Router (Website Build — Not a Foundation Model)
records.benchmark: FDS Kayla Golden Query Regression Suite v2
records.conditions: Offline deterministic local routing (no external LLM provider); Tier 1/2/3 invariant verification
records.uncertainty: Deterministic suite (0% sampling variance); measures repository-fact recall only, not open-ended reasoning
records.limitations: Evaluates local canonical routing and safety invariants on this public website only; does not benchmark general LLM intelligence.
